pose_constraints.posture: Sturdy, low-slung 'Pillar' stance; head tilted slightly upward to maximize the vertical display of the nasal horn and frill spikes.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The massive nasal horn is the central vertical axis.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking slightly up to emphasize the height of the nasal horn and the surrounding frill spikes.
pose_constraints.grounding: Standing on flat, dark, damp soil; all four feet clustered tightly to avoid horizontal sprawl.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Torso, hips, and tail are completely occluded by the front chest and head. Silhouette must remain under 280px wide.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The nasal horn and the symmetrically arranged frill spikes must be fully visible and centered, forming the vertical 'crown' of the silhouette.

character_details.expression: Stern but curious gaze; large, amber-colored eyes.
character_details.texture: Thick, scaly hide with rough, battle-scarred texture around the frill and horns.
features: Massive, prominent nasal horn pointing directly forward and slightly upward.
Six long, symmetrical spikes radiating from the frill's edge.
Small brow horns above the eyes.

environmental_details.ground: Saturated dark brown soil mixed with fallen conifer needles and wet moss.
flora: Dense thickets of giant horsetails (Equisetum) and broad-leaved angiosperms (magnolias) in the soft-focus background
environmental_details.sky: Overcast, humid Late Cretaceous sky with soft, diffused lighting that highlights the texture of the horns.
environmental_details.lighting: Subtle top-down light emphasizing the three-dimensional form of the horns and spikes, avoiding harsh shadows.
